newsitem.title: USA: General Semiconductor Q2 net loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: General Semiconductor Q2 net loss narrows.

text.p: Three Months Ended Three Months Ended

NOTE: Company issued pro forma results to reflect the spin-off of NextLevel Systems Inc and CommScope Inc from the General Instrument Co on July 28. General Instrument then changed its name to General Semiconductor.
(A) - Pro forma information assumes the conversion of the convertible notes and a net debt level of $275.0 million at the beginning of all periods presented.

(B) - Excluding the $26.4 million ($19.8 million net of tax) of charges related to the restructuring (primarily employee costs related to the separation of the Company's Taiwan operations and costs directly related to the spin-off), pro forma operating income and income from continuing operations would have been $18.8 million and $8.7 million ($0.24 per share), respectively, for the three months ended June 30, 1997. These costs include $25.4 million charged to cost of sales and $1.0 million charged to selling, general and administrative expense.
(C) - All share information has been retroactively restated to reflect the 1 for 4 reverse stock split effected at the time of the spin-off.
(D) - Fully diluted earnings (loss) per share for discontinued operations and net loss per share are anti-dilutive and therefore are not presented.
(A) - Pro forma information assumes the conversion of the convertible notes and a net debt level of $275.0 million at the beginning of all periods presented.

(B) - Excluding the $33.8 million ($25.3 million net of tax) of charges related to the restructuring (primarily employee costs related to the separation of the Company's Taiwan operations and costs directly related to the spin-off), pro forma operating income and pro forma income from continuing operations would have been $31.7 million and $13.8 million ($0.37 per share), respectively, for the six months ended June 30, 1997. These costs include $32.7 million charged to cost of sales and $1.1 million charged to selling, general and administrative expense.
(C) - All share information has been retroactively restated to reflect the 1 for 4 reverse stock split effected at the time of the spin-off.
(D) - Fully diluted earnings (loss) per share for discontinued operations and net income (loss) per share are anti-dilutive and therefore are not presented.
